verdict.rationale: The pack documents no first-party way to define general automations or agent workflows that PayPal runs autonomously in the background. The agent toolkit, MCP server, webhooks and Disputes API are developer building blocks for constructing such automations. Recurring subscription billing and automatic invoice reminders are narrow, adjacent product features rather than a configurable automation capability, so none of this earns credit for the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
